body: # 9-5 Taxable supplies You make a [*taxable supply*](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-taxable-supply) if: **(a)** you make the [*supply*](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-supply) for *consideration; and **(b)** the supply is made in the course or furtherance of an [*enterprise*](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-enterprise) that you *carry on; and **(c)** the supply is *connected with the [*indirect tax zone*](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-indirect-tax-zone); and **(d)** you are [*registered](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-registered), or [*required to be registered](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-required-to-be-registered). However, the supply is not a [*taxable supply*](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-taxable-supply) to the extent that it is [*GST-free*](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-gst-free) or [*input taxed](/gst-1999/s195-1#s195-1-input-taxed). --- *Last updated: 2026-01-01 (Compilation 96)*
